commands.cmd:
V="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/research-evaluation/venv"; /usr/bin/timeout 180 bwrap --unshare-net --die-with-parent --ro-bind / / --dev /dev --proc /proc "$V/bin/python" -s -c "
from skfolio import RiskMeasure
from skfolio.datasets import load_sp500_dataset
from skfolio.model_selection import WalkForward,cross_val_predict
from skfolio.optimization import EqualWeighted,MeanRisk
from skfolio.preprocessing import prices_to_returns
X=prices_to_returns(load_sp500_dataset())
mv=MeanRisk(risk_measure=RiskMeasure.VARIANCE).fit(X);w=mv.weights_
v_mv=mv.predict(X).variance;v_ew=EqualWeighted().fit(X).predict(X).variance
cv=cross_val_predict(MeanRisk(risk_measure=RiskMeasure.VARIANCE),X,cv=WalkForward(train_size=252,test_size=63))
try:
    MeanRisk(min_weights=0.2).fit(X);ctrl='accepted'
except Exception as e: ctrl=type(e).__name__
ok=abs(w.sum()-1)<1e-6 and w.min()>-1e-8 and v_mv<v_ew and len(cv.portfolios)==(len(X)-252)//63 and ctrl!='accepted'
print('bundled S&P 500 sample:',X.shape[1],'assets x',X.shape[0],'days | min-variance weights sum',round(float(w.sum()),6),'min',round(float(w.min()),9),'| in-sample variance',round(float(v_mv),8),'< equal weight',round(float(v_ew),8),'| walk-forward test folds',len(cv.portfolios),'| infeasible min_weights=0.2 over 20 assets refused:',ctrl)
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)"
